/* Header File Name: SYS/LAYOUT                                      */
/*                                                                   */
/* Descriptive Name: This header contains all of the prototypes,     */
/*                   constants, etc. needed to interface to any API  */
/*                   functions contained in the QTQLAYOUT *SRVPGM.   */
/*                                                                   */
/*                   This service program contains the X/Open layout */
/*                   services API's for the interface defined in     */
/*                   "X/Open, Portable Layout Services:  Context-    */
/*                   dependent and Directional Text", X/Open         */
/*                   document number C616, ISBN 1-85912-142.X.       */
/*                                                                   */
/*                   This service program will run as *INHERIT state */
/*                   and *USER domain.                               */
/*                                                                   */
/*                                                                   */
/* Description:      This file supports the following functions:     */
/*                                                                   */
/*               --> m_create_layout                                 */
/*                                                                   */
/*                      ( Initialise a layout object               ) */
/*                      function creates a LayoutObject associated   */
/*                      with the locale identified by an attribute   */
/*                      object.                                      */
/*                                                                   */
/*               --> m_destroy_layout                                */
/*                                                                   */
/*                      ( Destroy a layout object                  ) */
/*                      function destroys a LayoutObject by          */
/*                      deallocating the layout object and all the   */
/*                      associated resources previously allocated    */
/*                      by the m_create_layout() function.           */
/*                                                                   */
/*               --> m_getvalues_layout                              */
/*                                                                   */
/*                      ( Query layout values of a LayoutObject    ) */
/*                      function is used to query the current        */
/*                      setting of layout values within a            */
/*                      LayoutObject.                                */
/*                                                                   */
/*               --> m_setvalues_layout                              */
/*                                                                   */
/*                      ( Set layout values of a LayoutObject      ) */
/*                      function is used to change the layout values */
/*                      of a LayoutObject.                           */
/*                                                                   */
/*               --> m_transform_layout                              */
/*                                                                   */
/*                      ( Layout transformation                    ) */
/*                      function transforms the input text of an     */
/*                      input buffer according to the current layout */
/*                      values within a LayoutObject.                */
/*                                                                   */
/*               --> m_wtransform_layout                             */
/*                                                                   */
/*                      ( Layout transformation for wchar_t string ) */
/*                      function transforms the input text of an     */
/*                      input buffer for wide character strings      */
/*                      according to the current layout values       */
/*                      within a LayoutObject.                       */
/*                                                                   */
/* Header Files Included:       stddef.h                             */
/*                                                                   */
/* Macros List:                 None.                                */
/*                                                                   */
/* Function Prototype List:     m_create_layout                      */
/*                              m_destroy_layout                     */
/*                              m_getvalues_layout                   */
/*                              m_setvalues_layout                   */
/*                              m_transform_layout                   */
/*                              m_wtransform_layout                  */

#ifndef _LAYOUT_H
#define _LAYOUT_H

/*********************************************************************/
/* Includes...                                                       */
/*********************************************************************/

#include <stddef.h>
#ifdef MEM_DEBUG
#include "heapdbg.h" /* for memory leaks debugging */
#endif

/*********************************************************************/
/* Constants...                                                      */
/*********************************************************************/

#define AllTextDescriptors      0x0000007f

#define Orientation             (1L)
#define Context                 (1L<<1)
#define TypeOfText              (1L<<2)
#define ImplicitAlg             (1L<<3)
#define Swapping                (1L<<4)
#define Numerals                (1L<<5)
#define TextShaping             (1L<<6)

#define ActiveDirectional       (1L<<16)
#define ActiveShapeEditing      (1L<<17)
#define ShapeCharset            (1L<<18)
#define ShapeCharsetSize        (1L<<19)
#define ShapeContextSize        (1L<<20)
#define InOutTextDescrMask      (1L<<21)
#define InOnlyTextDescr         (1L<<22)
#define OutOnlyTextDescr        (1L<<23)
#define CheckMode               (1L<<24)
#define QueryValueSize          (1L<<25)

/* Possible values for Orientation */
#define ORIENTATION_LTR         0x00000001
#define ORIENTATION_RTL         0x00000002
#define ORIENTATION_TTBRL       0x00000003
#define ORIENTATION_TTBLR       0x00000004
#define ORIENTATION_CONTEXTUAL  0x00000005

/* Possible values for Context */
#define CONTEXT_LTR             0x00000010
#define CONTEXT_RTL             0x00000020

/* Possible values for TypeOfText */
#define TEXT_IMPLICIT           0x00000100
#define TEXT_EXPLICIT           0x00000200
#define TEXT_VISUAL             0x00000300

/* Possible values for ImplicitAlg */
#define ALGOR_BASIC             0x00001000
#define ALGOR_IMPLICIT          0x00002000

/* Possible values for Swapping */
#define SWAPPING_NO             0x00010000
#define SWAPPING_YES            0x00020000

/* Possible values for Numerals */
#define NUMERALS_NOMINAL        0x00100000
#define NUMERALS_NATIONAL       0x00200000
#define NUMERALS_CONTEXTUAL     0x00300000

/* Possible values for TextShaping */
#define TEXT_SHAPED             0x01000000
#define TEXT_NOMINAL            0x02000000
#define TEXT_SHFORM1            0x03000000
#define TEXT_SHFORM2            0x04000000
#define TEXT_SHFORM3            0x05000000
#define TEXT_SHFORM4            0x06000000

/* Possible values for CheckMode */
#define MODE_STREAM             0x00000001
#define MODE_EDIT               0x00000002


#define MaskAllTextDescriptors  0x0fffffff
#define MaskOrientation         0x0000000f
#define MaskContext             0x000000f0
#define MaskTypeOfText          0x00000f00
#define MaskImplicitAlg         0x0000f000
#define MaskSwapping            0x000f0000
#define MaskNumerals            0x00f00000
#define MaskTextShaping         0x0f000000

/* Mask for the Property parament of m_*transform() */
#define NESTLEVEL_MASK          0x0f
#define DISPLAYCELL_MASK        0x10

/*********************************************************************/
/* Type definitions...                                               */
/*********************************************************************/

typedef int        LayoutId;
typedef int        BooleanValue;
typedef void      *LayoutValue;

typedef struct {
    LayoutId       name;
    LayoutValue    value;
} LayoutValueRec, *LayoutValues;

typedef int        LayoutDesc;
typedef struct {
    LayoutDesc     inp;
    LayoutDesc     out;
} LayoutTextDescriptorRec, *LayoutTextDescriptor;

typedef struct {
    int            front;
    int            back;
} LayoutEditSizeRec, *LayoutEditSize;

typedef struct _LayoutObject *LayoutObject;           /* Public name */

/*********************************************************************/
/*                                                                   */
/*                    Prototype for Calling                          */
/*                       m_create_layout                             */
/*                                                                   */
/*  Input/Output:                                                    */
/*                                                                   */
/*  const void *          -> Attribute object usually a locale.      */
/*  const char *          -> Modifier of values for LayoutObject.    */
/*                                                                   */
/*  Returns:                                                         */
/*     Success:           -> Returns a LayoutObject for use in       */
/*                           subsequent calls to m_*_layout          */
/*                           functions.                              */
/*                                                                   */
/*     Error:             -> A (LayoutObject)0 indicates that an     */
/*                           error occured.                          */
/*                                                                   */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef __cplusplus
   extern "C"
#endif

LayoutObject m_create_layout(
    const void *                /* attrobj */,
    const char *                /* modifier */
);

/*  Returns:                                                         */

/*     Error:             -> A value of -1 is returned.              */
/*                                                                   */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef __cplusplus
   extern "C"
#endif

int m_destroy_layout(
    const LayoutObject          /* layoutobject */

/*                    Prototype for Calling                          */
/*                      m_getvalues_layout                           */
/*                                                                   */
/*  Input/Output:                                                    */
/*                                                                   */
/*  const LayoutObject    -> Object to query current layout values.  */
/*        LayoutValues    -> List of layout values to be queried.    */
/*        int *           -> Index of value causing error on query.  */
/*                                                                   */
/*  Returns:                                                         */
/*     Success:           -> A value of zero is returned.            */
/*                                                                   */
/*     Error:             -> A value of -1 is returned.              */
/*                                                                   */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef __cplusplus
   extern "C"
#endif

int m_getvalues_layout(
    const LayoutObject          /* layoutobject */,
          LayoutValues          /* values */,
          int *                 /* index_returned */
);

/*     Success:           -> A value of zero is returned.            */
/*                                                                   */
/*     Error:             -> A value of -1 is returned.              */

int m_setvalues_layout(

          int *                 /* index_returned */

/*--**--**--**--**--**--**--**--**---**--**--**--**--**--**--**--**--*/
/* Start of m_transform_layout API function information...           */
/*--**--**--**--**--**--**--**--**---**--**--**--**--**--**--**--**--*/

/*********************************************************************/
/*                                                                   */
/*                    Prototype for Calling                          */
/*                      m_transform_layout                           */
/*                                                                   */
/*  Input/Output:                                                    */
/*                                                                   */
/*           LayoutObject -> Object to base transformation upon.     */
/*  const    char *       -> Source text to be processed.            */
/*  const    size_t       -> Number of characters in source text.    */
/*           void *       -> Place to store transformed data.        */
/*           size_t *     -> Number of transformed bytes.            */
/*           size_t *     -> Cross reference source to transformed.  */
/*           size_t *     -> Cross reference transformed to source.  */
/*  unsigned char *       -> Weighted value for special tranforms.   */
/*           size_t *     -> Offset to location of transformed text. */
/*                                                                   */
/*  Returns:                                                         */
/*     Success:           -> A value of zero is returned.            */
/*                                                                   */
/*     Error:             -> A value of -1 is returned.              */
/*                                                                   */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef __cplusplus
   extern "C"
#endif

int m_transform_layout(
             LayoutObject       /* layoutobject */,
    const    char *             /* InpBuf */,
    const    size_t             /* InpSize */,
             void *             /* OutBuf */,
             size_t *           /* OutSize */,
             size_t *           /* InpToOut */,
             size_t *           /* OutToInp */,
    unsigned char *             /* Property */,
             size_t *           /* InpBufIndex */
);

/*--**--**--**--**--**--**--**--**---**--**--**--**--**--**--**--**--*/
/* Start of m_wtransform_layout API function information...          */

/*                                                                   */
/*                    Prototype for Calling                          */
/*                     m_wtransform_layout                           */
/*                                                                   */
/*  Input/Output:                                                    */
/*                                                                   */
/*           LayoutObject -> Object to base transformation upon.     */
/*  const    wchar_t *    -> Source text to be processed.            */
/*  const    size_t       -> Number of characters in source text.    */
/*           void *       -> Place to store transformed data.        */
/*           size_t *     -> Number of transformed wide characters.  */
/*           size_t *     -> Cross reference source to transformed.  */
/*           size_t *     -> Cross reference transformed to source.  */
/*  unsigned char *       -> Weighted value for special tranforms.   */
/*           size_t *     -> Offset to location of transformed text. */
/*                                                                   */
/*  Returns:                                                         */
/*     Success:           -> A value of zero is returned.            */
/*                                                                   */
/*     Error:             -> A value of -1 is returned.              */
/*                                                                   */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifdef __cplusplus
   extern "C"
#endif

int m_wtransform_layout(
             LayoutObject       /* layoutobject */,
    const    wchar_t *          /* InpBuf */,
    const    size_t             /* InpSize */,
             void *             /* OutBuf */,
             size_t *           /* OutSize */,
             size_t *           /* InpToOut */,
             size_t *           /* OutToInp */,
    unsigned char *             /* Property */,
             size_t *           /* InpBufIndex */
);
